name: ADB-FUBINACA
summary: ADB-FUBINACA (ADMB-FUBINACA) is a designer drug identified in synthetic cannabis blends in Japan in 2013. In 2018, it was the third-most common synthetic cannabinoid identified in drugs seized by the Drug Enforcement Administration.

pharmacology.text: The (S)-enantiomer of ADB-FUBINACA is described in a 2009 Pfizer patent and has been reported to be a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and the CB2 receptor with EC50 values of 1.2 nM and 3.5 nM, respectively.

uses.text: ADB-FUBINACA (ADMB-FUBINACA) is a designer drug identified in synthetic cannabis blends in Japan in 2013.

sideEffects.text: One death through coronary arterial thrombosis has been linked to ADB-FUBINACA intoxication.

fact.en: The FUB in its name means a fluorobenzyl group. In 2018 it was the third most common synthetic cannabinoid in drugs seized by the United States Drug Enforcement Administration.
